actors.name: Donald Trump
actors.blurb: Donald Trump dominates the news cycle through aggressive midterm campaigning, a flurry of executive actions, international controversies involving Iran and Cuba, and a Department of Justice lawsuit challenging the Alaska Senate race. He has also traded public barbs with Barack Obama and made sweeping policy announcements regarding housing, trade tariffs, and federal land regulations.

actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.blurb: Marine Le Pen has officially launched her presidential campaign with a major address in Orléans ahead of national congress events. Leading recent polls with up to 38% support six months before the election, she is attempting to position her party around a message of 'renaissance' and national optimism amidst widespread social protests.

actors.name: JD Vance
actors.role: Vice President of the United States
actors.blurb: Vice President JD Vance is maintaining high visibility by fronting Republican midterm campaign efforts across the country, which analysts view as a dry run for a future White House bid. He has also faced sharp criticism from figures like Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro over campaign controversies and defense policy alignments.

actors.name: Dan Sullivan
actors.blurb: Dan Sullivan is at the center of a major electoral dispute as the Trump administration and Department of Justice launch a federal lawsuit to block the certification of Alaska's Senate race if he loses. The legal challenge centers around voter confusion and a spoiler candidate on the ballot.

actors.name: Matteo Salvini
actors.blurb: Matteo Salvini is navigating intense internal party pressures as the Lega congress opens in Italy. He faces direct challenges from within his own ranks, notably from Massimo Garavaglia, who is pushing for a return to political pragmatism.
